patches.title: Countertop Priority Scan
patches.principle: Search all countertops in order before moving to other furniture types.
patches.when_to_apply: When the target object is not visible on initial countertop.

patches.title: Avoid Redundant Information Actions
patches.principle: Do not use 'look' or 'inventory' actions during task; they waste steps and reveal no new object locations.
patches.when_to_apply: Anytime during object search or manipulation.

patches.title: Hold Object Directly to Sink
patches.principle: After picking up the target object, go immediately to the sinkbasin without opening any containers.
patches.when_to_apply: When holding an object that needs cleaning.
